//! Probe: the sanctioned composition-root escape hatch.
//!
//! A reasoned `#[expect]` over a genuine composition root must compile with no
//! diagnostic at all: neither `disallowed_methods` nor an unfulfilled
//! expectation.

#[expect(
    clippy::disallowed_methods,
    reason = "composition root: probe for the sanctioned escape hatch"
)]
pub fn reads() {
    let _ = std::env::var("WILDSIDE_PROBE");
}
